title: Macterm extension
description: extension.yaml: a Macterm extension as a whole — what Settings → Extensions shows and who maintains it. The extension's capabilities sit beside it in its folder: for now, palettes, one YAML file each in palettes/ (assets/palette.schema.json).

name.description: The extension's name on its card in Settings → Extensions.

description.description: One line on its card saying what the extension is for, starting with a verb.

icon.description: An SF Symbol name for its card. Defaults to puzzlepiece.extension.

authors.description: The GitHub usernames of the people who maintain it.
